from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

BASE = Path("morsehgp3D_v8/audits").resolve()
ROOT = BASE.parents[1]
OLD_HASH = "147e744f3aa30b76973cb66d31a580ae6c05e22592d0e8af11ea6095e5b248c2"
old_path = BASE / "P0_OWNER_CHECKS.json"
old_bytes = old_path.read_bytes()
if hashlib.sha256(old_bytes).hexdigest() != OLD_HASH:
    raise RuntimeError("integration.previous_receipt_pin")
old = json.loads(old_bytes)
helper_scope = {"__name__": "owner_helpers", "__file__": str(BASE / "p0_owner_checks.py")}
exec(compile(old["runner"]["text"], "archived_owner_helpers", "exec"), helper_scope)
pin, command = helper_scope["pin"], helper_scope["command"]
digest, require = helper_scope["digest"], helper_scope["require"]
output = Path(OUTPUT).resolve()
require(output.parent == BASE and not output.exists(), "integration.create_only_output")
replay = globals().get("SNAPSHOT")
receipt = {
    "status": "failed", "scope": "live P0 owner integration, two four-point q2 fixtures",
    "full_qualification": False, "performance_claim": False, "gcp_used": False,
    "previous_receipt": {"path": str(old_path.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": OLD_HASH},
    "reproducer_source": REPRODUCER_SOURCE,
    "replay_command": "python3 -B -c 'import json,sys; x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); exec(compile(x[\"reproducer_source\"],\"owner_integration_replay\",\"exec\"),{\"REPRODUCER_SOURCE\":x[\"reproducer_source\"],\"SNAPSHOT\":x,\"OUTPUT\":sys.argv[2]})' morsehgp3D_v8/audits/P0_OWNER_INTEGRATION.json morsehgp3D_v8/audits/P0_OWNER_INTEGRATION_REPLAY.json",
    "replayed": bool(replay), "commands": [], "runs": []
}
workspace = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".work_owner_integrated_", dir=BASE))
try:
    require(digest(old["runner"]["text"].encode()) == old["runner"]["sha256"],
            "integration.archived_runner")
    require(digest(old["gate"]["text"].encode()) == old["gate"]["sha256"],
            "integration.archived_gate")
    receipt["runner"] = {"path": old["runner"]["path"], "sha256": old["runner"]["sha256"],
                         "text_reference": "previous_receipt.runner.text"}
    receipt["gate"] = {"path": old["gate"]["path"], "sha256": old["gate"]["sha256"],
                       "text_reference": "previous_receipt.gate.text"}
    require(pin(BASE / "p0_owner_gate.cpp")["sha256"] == old["gate"]["sha256"],
            "integration.live_gate_changed")
    require(pin(BASE / "p0_owner_checks.py")["sha256"] == old["runner"]["sha256"],
            "integration.live_runner_changed")
    texts, receipt["sources"] = {}, {}
    for name, previous in old["sources"].items():
        path = ROOT / previous["path"]
        if replay:
            item = replay["sources"][name]
            text = item.get("text", previous["text"])
            require(digest(text.encode()) == item["sha256"], "integration.replay_source")
        else:
            text = path.read_text()
        item = {"path": previous["path"], "sha256": digest(text.encode())}
        if item["sha256"] == previous["sha256"]:
            item["text_reference"] = "previous_receipt.sources." + name + ".text"
        else:
            item["text"] = text
        receipt["sources"][name] = item
        texts[name] = text
    require(receipt["sources"]["pipeline/local_credits.hpp"]["sha256"] ==
            "f6c89476f959c74dbaae1b2e52b3319dd46f863299fcfd7453bee5ebd42360a0",
            "integration.target_header")
    compiler = Path(shutil.which("g++") or "missing-g++").resolve()
    environment = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR=str(workspace))
    version = command([str(compiler), "--version"], 10, environment, compiler)
    receipt["commands"].append(version)
    require(version["exit_code"] == 0, "integration.compiler_version")
    receipt["head_at_capture"] = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
    for mode in ("o2", "san"):
        folder = workspace / mode
        for name, text in texts.items():
            path = folder / "src" / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_text(text)
        gate = folder / "gate.cpp"
        gate.write_text(old["gate"]["text"])
        paths = {name: folder / "src" / name for name in texts}
        paths["gate.cpp"] = gate
        run = {"mode": mode, "source_before": {name: pin(path) for name,path in paths.items()},
               "commands": []}
        receipt["runs"].append(run)
        binary = folder / "owner_gate"
        flags = ["-O2"] if mode == "o2" else ["-O1", "-g0",
            "-fsanitize=address,undefined", "-fno-omit-frame-pointer", "-no-pie"]
        argv = [str(compiler), "-std=c++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic",
                "-Werror", *flags, "-I", str(folder / "src"), str(gate),
                str(folder / "src/pipeline/local_credits.cpp"), "-o", str(binary)]
        build = command(argv, 30, environment, compiler)
        run["commands"].append(build)
        require(build["exit_code"] == 0 and not build["timed_out"], "integration.compile")
        test_env = dict(environment)
        if mode == "san":
            test_env.update(ASAN_OPTIONS="detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=1",
                            UBSAN_OPTIONS="halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1")
        run["sanitizer_environment"] = {key:test_env[key] for key in
            ("ASAN_OPTIONS","UBSAN_OPTIONS") if key in test_env}
        expected = {"status": "passed_owner_closure", "closed_special_members": 4,
                    "nominal_pairs": [1,4], "product_scope": "P0_only",
                    "full_qualification": False, "gcp_used": False}
        for label, options, code in (("selftest", ["--selftest"], 0),
                                     ("missing", [], 2), ("unknown", ["--unknown"], 2)):
            result = command([str(binary), *options], 10, test_env, binary)
            result["label"] = label
            run["commands"].append(result)
            require(result["exit_code"] == code and not result["timed_out"] and
                    result["stderr"] == "", "integration.execution_" + label)
            require(json.loads(result["stdout"]) == expected if label == "selftest" else
                    result["stdout"] == "", "integration.stdout_" + label)
        run["source_after"] = {name:pin(path) for name,path in paths.items()}
        require(run["source_before"] == run["source_after"], "integration.copy_changed")
    commands = receipt["commands"] + [c for r in receipt["runs"] for c in r["commands"]]
    for item in commands:
        require(item["executable_before"] == item["executable_after"],
                "integration.executable_changed")
    for run in receipt["runs"]:
        require(run["commands"][0]["executable_before"]["sha256"] ==
                version["executable_before"]["sha256"], "integration.compiler_changed")
    receipt["status"] = "passed_bounded_live_owner_integration"
except Exception as error:
    receipt["error"] = str(error)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(workspace)
    receipt["temporary_workspace_removed"] = not workspace.exists()
    receipt["live_source_after"] = {name:pin(ROOT / item["path"])
                                     for name,item in old["sources"].items()}
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(receipt, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":receipt["status"], "receipt":str(output)}))
raise SystemExit(0 if receipt["status"] == "passed_bounded_live_owner_integration" else 1)
